verdict.rationale: The API docs imply plan approval is a per-session setting: approval is needed only "if your session requires explicit plan approval". The optional `automationMode` field controls automatic PR creation, which by default does not happen. Together these suggest sessions can run without step-by-step confirmation, but the evidence never names an explicit auto-approve-all setting or shows how to configure it. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a setting that auto-approves all actions (plans, edits, PRs), configuration details for the web UI, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can configure an agent to auto-approve all its actions instead of confirming each one

citations.quote: If your session requires explicit plan approval, you can approve the latest plan as follows
The `automationMode` field is optional. By default, no PR will be automatically created.
